vocabulary.definition: present everywhere at the same time
vocabulary.example: Microbes are omnipresent in our environment, from our phones to our bodies.
Our gut microbiome has co-evolved with us over millions of years.

vocabulary.definition: people or things that enter a place or situation where they are not wanted or allowed
vocabulary.example: The immune system protects our bodies from harmful intruders like bacteria.

vocabulary.definition: a person or thing that is used to trick or deceive someone
vocabulary.example: Certain sugars in mother's milk act as a decoy for harmful microbes.

vocabulary.definition: the tenth cranial nerve that extends from the brainstem to the abdomen and affects the heart, liver, and intestines
vocabulary.example: The gut microbiome communicates with the brain through the vagus nerve.

vocabulary.definition: to transfer tissue or an organ from one body to another
vocabulary.example: A poop transplant from a healthy donor can help restore a balanced microbiome.
